SERVICE_PUBLIC.DESC: Participate in organizing services for Memorial and Veterans Day at the Veterans Memorial Park in Harlingen. We also sponsor Wreaths Across America for the lower Rio Grande Valley. This involves hours of fundraising prior to the placing of several hundred wreaths on the graves of those who have served our great country.
SERVICE_PUBLIC.ACCOMPLISH: Our mission is to ensure that all service members are given the respect they deserve for their devotion to our country. Everything the board does is to edify the selfless service of our armed forces.
